data.name: Eiadah
data.gender_notes: Eiadah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Eiadah means calm and peaceful, symbolizing a serene and tranquil state of mind. The name Eiadah carries the meaning “Calm and peaceful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Eiadah usually hope their child will grow to embody calm and peaceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name mentioned in Quranic verse, representing inner peace and serenity.
data.etymology: Eiadah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Calm and peaceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eiadah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: عيداه
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عربي مشتق من كلمة عيد، ويشير إلى الفرح والسرور والاحتفال بالعيد. يستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية ليعبر عن الفرح والبهجة.

in_urdu.name: عیدہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عیدہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جو عید اور جشن کے معنی میں ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں فرح اور خوشی کے اظہار کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ईदाह
in_hindi.long_meaning: ईदाह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में ख़ुशी और त्योहार के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है। यह नाम अरबी मूल से है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका महत्वपूर्ण स्थान है।

in_pashto.name: عيداه
in_pashto.long_meaning: په پښتو کې د عيداه نوم د جشن او فرح معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتني کلتور په اسلامی دود کې د خوښۍ او جشن د څرګندولو لپاره کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Eiadah
in_english.meaning: Name related to Eid and joy
in_english.long_meaning: Eiadah is an Arabic name derived from 'Eid', signifying joy, celebration, and happiness. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes festive occasions and spiritual elation. Historically, the name reflects the significance of Eid celebrations in Muslim cultures worldwide.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: عيداه

data.cultural_impact: The name Eiadah evokes a sense of calmness and peace, which is highly valued in Islamic culture. It is often given to babies with the hope that they will grow up to be calm, patient, and composed individuals. In a society where chaos and stress are commonplace, a name like Eiadah serves as a constant reminder to strive for inner peace and tranquility.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Eiadah represents a person who has found peace and contentment within themselves, despite the challenges and hardships of life. It is the name of someone who has tamed their mind and emotions, and has achieved a deep, inner stillness that allows them to connect with the divine. In this way, Eiadah is a reminder of our ultimate goal - to cultivate an inner peace that allows us to fully experience the presence and love of God.
